lessons.title: Stress-test training-sample sensitivity in volatile markets
lessons.statement: When training data mixes changing market conditions, consider this source-backed action: As a proposed adaptation, compare fitted behavior and error across temporal training windows rather than trusting one sample. Proposed check: Check predictions and errors on successive held-out regimes. Limit: The source reports instability without documenting a time-split protocol; no model superiority follows.
